question: If the radius of the base of a right circular cylinder is decreased by 23% and its height is increased by 151%, then what is the percentage increase (closest integer) in its volume?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The volume of a cylinder is proportional to r²h.

Net percentage change in r² (successive decrease of 23%) = −23 − 23 + (23 × 23) ÷ 100 = −46 + 5.29 = −40.71%

Net change in volume combining r² change and height change (+151%) = −40.71 + 151 − (40.71 × 151) ÷ 100

⇒ Total change = 110.29 − 61.4721 = +48.8179%

Rounding to the closest integer gives a 49% increase.

**∴ The correct answer is 49%.**
